# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform updates**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes improve rendering correctness and refresh Apple and Uno platform requirements. Android texture render loops follow display refresh, Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicts with system libraries, and native callbacks use the correct boolean widths. Apple deployment floors rise, while Uno views move to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native deployment floors are now macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, with managed minima aligned for Xcode 27 builds. Raise application deployment targets to at least these versions; retain any higher framework requirement. .NET 9 targets remain supported. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Uno applications to Uno Platform 7** — Non-Windows Uno views now require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10; legacy platform runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are retired. Migrate to Uno.Sdk 7 and the .NET SDK WASM pipeline. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid and uses a CPU fallback with null GRContext outside Windows; use SKCanvasElement for GPU drawing. Update code relying on its former base type or removed RaiseOnUnsupported member. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use matching rebuilt WebAssembly native archives** — Newer-than-.NET 8 WebGPU consumers need rebuilt libSkiaSharp.a archives containing emdawnwebgpu C++ support. Upgrade native assets alongside the managed package, and include that support in custom Graphite builds; old or GPU-disabled custom archives do not meet the link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Safer SkSL and region processing** — Same-milestone Skia m156 fixes reject overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, prevent execution of partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines, and correctly size region storage for subdivided conics. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))
- **GPU rendering correctness** — Graphite preserves cap and join bounds for hairline and subpixel strokes and compares complete paint keys. Ganesh disables a BGRA upload configuration invalid in OpenGL ES, without changing readback. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous frames, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follow Choreographer display callbacks rather than buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent, and request-driven rendering is preserved. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order conflicts** — Bundled HarfBuzz function calls stay within libHarfBuzzSharp.so, preventing incompatible private objects from crossing into system HarfBuzz when GTK or another library loads it first. The common Linux recipe, including nodeps and clang-cross variants, carries the fix. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Native callback boolean widths** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, addressing Apple ARM64 interpreter return handling and false-returning HarfBuzz callbacks. Public managed delegates and APIs continue to use bool. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **String conversion validation** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit: ASCII for UTF-8, one BMP unit for UTF-16, or one code point for UTF-32. Null byte arrays passed to GetString now throw ArgumentNullException instead of NullReferenceException. FromCString also receives a native buffer over-read fix. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower allocation overhead** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation while preserving decoding behavior and legacy target frameworks. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integrations** — WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118 with matching packaged PDB names. Windows library dependencies move to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003, aligned with MAUI 9 and 10, without changing declared Windows runtime minima. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
